# HTML Playground

> Free online HTML, CSS, and JavaScript editor with live preview.

## About

HTML Playground is a browser-based code editor for writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It provides real-time preview, snippet sharing, and project organization — no local setup required.

## Key Features

- Live HTML, CSS, and JavaScript editing with instant browser preview
- Shareable snippet links with public/private permissions
- Dark and light mode themes
- Mobile responsive — edit on phone or tablet
- Save snippets without an account, or sign up to organize projects
- Download snippets as HTML files

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/snippets` — Create a new snippet
- `GET /api/snippets/[shortId]` — Fetch a snippet
- `PATCH /api/snippets/[shortId]` — Update a snippet
- `DELETE /api/snippets/[shortId]` — Delete a snippet

## Pages

- `/` — Main editor with live preview
- `/auth` — Sign in or create an account
- `/dashboard` — Manage your saved snippets (requires auth)
- `/faq` — Frequently asked questions
- `/snippets/[id]` — View or edit a shared snippet

## Contact

For questions or feedback, open an issue on GitHub.
